metadata.description: Avery Ranch Golf Club is a 226 acre, 7121 yard, 18-hole championship public course offering 5 tee placements that will challenge the low-handicapper while creating an enjoyable golfing experience for all levels of players. Architect, Andy Raugust, has blended panoramic vistas and gentle rolling hills with oak-lined fairways and a 60-acre lake. Avery Ranch features the best Tif Eagle greens and 419 Bermuda fairways and tees in the Austin area. In fact, Avid Golfer Magazine ranks Avery Ranch #1 for Best Course Conditions, Best Clubhouse, Best Dining Area, and Best Innovative Design. Come experience Austin's Premier Daily-Fee Facility today. Avid Golfer Magazine rates Avery Ranch #1 for "Best Overall Course, Best Clubhouse, Best Dining Area, Best Par 4's, Best Par 5's, Best Closing Hole, and Best Cart Girls.

metadata.description:
Welcome to Coyote Ridge Golf Club, a North Dallas daily public fee golf destination where golf is more than just a game. We completed construction of our new 26,000-square foot luxury clubhouse in February 2007.  The new clubhouse is complete with luxury locker rooms for both men and women, state-of-the-art pro-shop, Grill 19 restaurant and bar that is open to the public, two private dining and meeting rooms (The Library and The Wine Room) and The Grand Ballroom that can accommodate up to 400 guests for your special event.
VOTED TOP 5 "BEST RENOVATIONS" BY AVID GOLFER MAGAZINE. FALL 2006.

metadata.description: Conveniently located in Euless, only ten minutes from Dallas/Fort Worth Airport, Texas Star provides golfers nationwide an opportunity to enjoy this Texas golf masterpiece. "Our job was to find the right holes for the land so that it feels like it has always been there," Texas Star Golf Architect Keith Foster says. Foster once again elevated the standards of Texas golf with his 1997 creation, Texas Star. Recipient of the coveted "4-star" rating from Golf Digest magazine, Texas Star features a unique landscape and design. Throughout the 275 acres, players encounter century old oak trees and an assortment of native grasses outlining the expansive fairways. The golf course was designed around Hurricane Creek, which meanders throughout the beautiful landscape of rolling hills, stacked rock ponds, waterfalls and natural woodlands.
